description: 한국환경공단_지하역사 실내공기질 자동측정망 측정데이터 초미세먼지 월별 확정 정보 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국환경공단. . - 해당 자료는 각 철도운영기관에서 생산하여 확정한 자료이며, 데이터 검증을 위한 확정 과정에서 약 2개월의 시간차가 있습니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국환경공단. Its tags are 지하역사, 실내공기질, 자동측정망, 초미세먼지, 오염도. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-04-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
